name: chest to bar pull-up
description: A strict pull-up taken high enough that the chest touches the bar. The extra height prepares you for the muscle-up.
instructions: Hang from the bar with an overhand grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Pull your shoulder blades down and back.
Pull hard until your upper chest touches the bar.
Drive your elbows down behind your body at the top.
Lower with control to straight arms.
